name: Full Body Program — Jeff Nippard
tagline: Jeff Nippard's Fundamentals program: 3 days/week, 8 weeks across two 4-week phases with RPE, rest, and form cues built in.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Pull your elbows straight down to your sides, use a 1.5× shoulder-width grip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.note: Focus on flexing your spine, don't yank your head with your arms.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.note: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright, clear your head out of the way, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
exercises.note: Use a V-bar grip; let your scapulae protract during the eccentric.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Medium feet placement on the platform, don't allow your lower back to round.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Tilt the dumbbell such that your pinky comes up first.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Supinated Curl
exercises.note: Drive your pinky into the handle harder than your pointer finger.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Tuck your chin and rib cage down, only move your hips. Use a pad.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Pull your elbows down against your sides, use shoulder-width grip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.note: 10 steps each leg. Take medium strides, let your torso lean forward.

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.note: Keep your scapulae retracted, pull your inner elbows together (not your hands).

exercises.name: Single-Arm Rope Tricep Extension
exercises.note: Pull your arm behind your torso, don't move your upper arm.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Tuck your chin and rib cage down, only move your hips. Use a pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.note: 10 steps each leg. Take medium strides, let your torso lean forward.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes, keep your hips low.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Pull your elbows straight down to your sides, use a 1.5× shoulder-width grip.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Press
exercises.note: Keep your scapulae retracted and depressed.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
exercises.note: Use a V-bar grip; let your scapulae protract during the eccentric.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Tilt the dumbbell such that your pinky comes up first.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
exercises.note: Face away from the cable you are using, keep your arm behind your torso.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Medium feet placement on the platform, don't allow your lower back to round.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.note: Focus on flexing your spine, don't yank your head with your arms.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright, clear your head out of the way, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Pull your elbows down against your sides, use shoulder-width grip.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, lean your torso forward 15°.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.note: Retract your scapulae during the concentric, protract your scapulae during the eccentric.

exercises.name: Seated Face Pull
exercises.note: Pull your arms back and out.

exercises.note: Keep your elbows in line with the top of your head, don't let your upper arm move.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, lean your torso forward 15°.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
exercises.note: Keep your elbows in line with the top of your head, don't let your upper arm move.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.note: Sit back and down, 15° toe flare, drive your knees out laterally.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Tuck your chin and rib cage down, only move your hips. Use a pad.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.note: Focus on flexing your spine, don't yank your head with your arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Pull your elbows down against your sides, use shoulder-width grip.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
exercises.note: Use a V-bar grip; let your scapulae protract during the eccentric.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
exercises.note: Retract your scapulae during the concentric, protract your scapulae during the eccentric.

exercises.name: Seated Face Pull
exercises.note: Pull your arms back and out.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Supinated Curl
exercises.note: Drive your pinky into the handle harder than your pointer finger.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.note: Brace your lats, chest tall, hips high, pull the slack out of the bar prior to moving it off the ground.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.note: 10 steps each leg. Take medium strides, let your torso lean forward.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lying Leg Curl
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your hamstrings to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Hip Abduction
exercises.note: Keep your butt in the seat, focus on squeezing your glutes to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes, keep your hips low.

exercises.name: Military Press
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes to keep your torso upright, clear your head out of the way, press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Tilt the dumbbell such that your pinky comes up first.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Flyes
exercises.note: Protract your scapulae, sweep the weight out and back.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Rope Tricep Extension
exercises.note: Pull your arm behind your torso, don't move your upper arm.

exercises.note: Face away from the cable you are using, keep your arm behind your torso.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Tuck elbows at a 45° angle, squeeze your shoulder blades and stay firm on the bench.
